functionalRequirement: The system shall provide a calendar view of available appointment slots for each healthcare provider

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must display all available appointment slots for each healthcare provider on the calendar view, covering 100% of the time slots within the specified date range.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a comprehensive view of all available slots, ensuring no slots are omitted.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately reflect the availability status of each slot, with a 99.9% accuracy rate when compared to the actual availability data.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise and correct representation of appointment availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must load the calendar view with all available slots within 2 seconds for up to 500 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time display of appointment slots, requiring quick loading times for user satisfaction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 100 MB of memory to display the calendar view for a single user session.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR’s focus on displaying multiple slots.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide intuitive navigation controls (e.g., next/previous month, day/week/month views) with clear labels and tooltips explaining their functions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires interaction with the calendar view, which should be easy to operate for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must prevent users from booking slots that are already taken or outside the provider's availability, with error messages displayed within 1 second of the user's action.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need to protect users from making erroneous bookings.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to display the calendar view for 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to the calendar view, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all appointment data using AES-256 encryption when stored in the database.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling sensitive appointment data, which requires protection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modularity: The calendar view functionality must be implemented as a separate module that can be updated independently without affecting other parts of the system.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a specific feature that should be maintainable without impacting the entire system.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to search for properties based on specific criteria such as location, area, and number of bedrooms

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must allow users to search for properties using all specified criteria (location, area, number of bedrooms) and return results for 100% of valid search queries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive search capabilities covering all mentioned criteria.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must return search results that accurately match the specified criteria with a 99.9% accuracy rate.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise and correct search results based on user input.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must return search results within 1 second for up to 1,000 concurrent searches.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time search functionality, requiring quick response times for user satisfaction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 200 MB of memory to process a single search query.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR’s focus on handling multiple search queries.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and intuitive search interface with labeled fields for each criterion (location, area, number of bedrooms) and a prominent search button.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires interaction with the search functionality, which should be easy to operate for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must validate user input for search criteria and display error messages within 500 milliseconds if invalid inputs are provided.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need to protect users from making erroneous searches.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to perform property searches for 99.95% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to the search functionality, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all user search queries using TLS 1.3 during transmission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling user input, which may contain sensitive information requiring protection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modularity: The search functionality must be implemented as a separate module that can be updated independently without affecting other parts of the system.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a specific feature that should be maintainable without impacting the entire system.
